# jotmd v0.0.2

This release fixes installation through Homebrew on macOS.

## Installation

jotmd is now distributed as a Homebrew Formula, so the unsigned CLI no longer triggers the Cask quarantine prompt.

Existing Cask installations need to be replaced once:

```sh
brew uninstall --cask gonfff/tap/jotmd
brew install gonfff/tap/jotmd
```
